newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Mark/yen consolidates, supported 72.95 yen.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Mark/yen consolidates, supported 72.95 yen.

text.p: The mark was consolidating against the yen in Europe with hefty support seen on dips below 73.00 yen, said analysts.

"We are trading in a congestion zone and don't expect much to happen between 72.95 and 73.80 marks," said Joachim Goldberg, Frankfurt-based global head of technical analysis at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
At 0817 GMT mark/yen was trading at 73.29 yen against 73.19 in late Europe on Friday.
Goldberg said mark/yen was likely to break on the upside after a period of consolidation.
"We are quite bullish on mark/yen medium-term," said Goldberg, adding that on dips a slice through 72.95 yen support would be cushioned lower down at 72.65 yen.
"The market would probably stop at this point, indicating a false break, and move up again," said Goldberg.
Analysts said upside continuation would be confirmed if the mark ripped through resistance around 74.00 yen, prompting a push all the way up to 74.50 yen and possibly higher.
"We would expect higher momentum on a break here," added Goldberg.
